data.name: Query_AllDataByHeaderId
data.value:
SELECT [INV_LoadingPointDetail].ItemID,INV_Item.Description as ItemName,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Rack.RackName,TransactionQuantity,DOQty, INV_Item.UnitWeight, INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure, ((TransactionQuantity * UnitWeight) / PrimaryUnitOfMeasure) AS QtyInBag, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName FROM [INV_LoadingPointDetail]
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].ItemID
INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].DOHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].DODetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].PeriodID
INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Rack ON SET_Rack.RackID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.RackID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 WHERE INV_LoadingPointDetail.[Status] = 1
AND (INV_LoadingPointDetail.[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND (INV_LoadingPointDetail.[LoadingPointHeaderID] = @LoadingPointHeaderID OR @LoadingPointHeaderID is null) AND (INV_LoadingPointDetail.[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

data.name: Query_AllDataByHeaderIdSSML
data.value:
SELECT [INV_LoadingPointDetail].ItemID,INV_Item.Description as ItemName,SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo,SET_Location.LocationName,SET_Rack.RackName,TransactionQuantity,DOQty, INV_Item.UnitWeight, INV_Item.PrimaryUnitOfMeasure, ((TransactionQuantity * UnitWeight) / PrimaryUnitOfMeasure) AS QtyInBag, Case when AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 then Agent.CustomerName when AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else '' end as CustomerName , AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered FROM [INV_LoadingPointDetail]
INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].ItemID
INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].DOHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].DODetailID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].PeriodID
INNER JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN SAL_ContractHeader ON SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID =SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID =[INV_LoadingPointDetail].LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Rack ON SET_Rack.RackID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.RackID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer as Agent ON Agent.CustomerID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.BrokerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND Agent.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND Agent.Status = 1
WHERE INV_LoadingPointDetail.[Status] = 1
AND (INV_LoadingPointDetail.[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND (INV_LoadingPointDetail.[LoadingPointHeaderID] = @LoadingPointHeaderID OR @LoadingPointHeaderID is null) AND (INV_LoadingPointDetail.[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

data.name: Query_GetAllDataByNoandDocumentType
data.value:
Select AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, * from INV_LoadingPointHeader inner join INV_LoadingPointDetail on INV_LoadingPointDetail.LoadingPointHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.LoadingPointHeaderID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointDetail.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOdetailID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CompanyID --and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID = INV_LoadingPointDetail.CurrentFiscalID
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.FiscalID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
where INV_LoadingPointHeader.Status=1 and INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo = @LoadingPointNo AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeId = @DocumentTypeId AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID= @PeriodID and INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = @FiscalID
